description: Get the option chain (calls and puts) for a stock for ONE expiration: strike, greeks (delta/gamma/theta/vega), implied volatility, open interest, the latest daily price and the previous traded session's volume. Defaults to the nearest upcoming expiration; pass expiration=YYYY-MM-DD for another (GetOptionExpirations lists them). A chain larger than maxResults returns the contracts nearest the money; narrow with minStrike/maxStrike and type to reach the wings. Each row dates its daily figures by session and its open interest by its own date, or marks either unknown; implied volatility and greeks are model values computed at fetch time. Daily figures are not live quotes. Bid/ask use real-time OPRA on Pro and a 15-minute delayed indicative feed on Plus; Free covers end-of-day data only. For a Canadian listing on XTSE or XTSX pass MIC:TICKER, e.g. XTSE:RY. Its chain carries the exchange's real-time bid/ask, implied volatility and open interest in CAD on Plus and Pro, plus computed greeks.

expiration.description: Expiration date in YYYY-MM-DD format (default: nearest upcoming)

maxStrike.description: Only include strikes at or below this price

minStrike.description: Only include strikes at or above this price

ticker.description: Stock ticker, e.g. AAPL, or MIC:TICKER for a TSX or TSXV listing, e.g. XTSE:RY

type.description: Contract type: call or put (default: both)

name: GetOptionChain
title: Option Chain
